text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock C after large gains, but a realized gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each position by its future risk and return.","After the account fell in Periods 4 and 5, I held rather than reacting to losses; I should keep decisions disciplined and not let loss aversion dictate them.","Because past price moves do not predict future moves, I should focus on diversification and my investment plan rather than treating recent performance as a forecast."]}
